mapper.sql: select id, seckill_id, good_id, seckill_price, stock, sold, limit_per_user, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by from seckill_good
mapper.insert: insert into seckill_good (seckill_id, good_id, seckill_price, stock, sold, limit_per_user, description, created_time, updated_time, created_by, updated_by) values (#{seckillId}, #{goodId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{stock}, #{sold}, #{limitPerUser}, #{description}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: update seckill_good set stock = stock + #{qty}, sold = GREATEST(sold - #{qty}, 0), updated_time = NOW() where id = #{id}
